test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A grocer purchased 50 kg of sugar at Rs. 40 per kg and mixed with 70 kg of sugar at Rs. ​30 per kg. At what rate should he sell the mixture (per kg) to gain 20%?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of 5
0 kg sugar at Rs. 40/kg = 50 × 40.

Cost price of 70 kg sugar at Rs. 30/kg = 70 × 30.

Total weight of sugar = 50 kg + 70 kg.

Gain = 20%.

**Formula Used:**

Total Cost Price = Sum of the cost prices of both types of sugar.

Selling Price = Total Cost Price + Gain% of Total Cost P
